================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO BAKENG SA AFTER EFFECTS - LINTHO TSE NCHA
Phatlalatso 9.2.8  -  Mphalane 2026
================================================================================

Panele e se e bua LIPUO TSE 132, ho na le LI-THEME tse ncha tsa DEMON SLAYER tse nang le sabole e
sehang li-button tseo u li tobetsang, hammoho le litokiso tse seng kae tsa layout le Windows.

PELE U QALA
- Kenya holim'a phatlalatso ea hau ea hajoale ka ZXP installer ea hau e tloaelehileng, ebe u qala
  After Effects hape hang.
- Litlhophiso tsa hau, theme, li-preset le li-expression tse bolokiloeng lia bolokoa.

E NCHA: PANELE KA LIPUO TSE 132
- Litlhophiso tsa Flex > PUO hona joale e bontša lipuo tse 132, ka lebokose la ho batla. Khetha e 'ngoe
  'me panele eohle e fetoha: li-tab, li-button, li-tooltip, melaetsa.
- Puo e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e fetoletsoe ke AI ho tsoa ho panele ea Senyesemane, eseng lentsoe ka lentsoe.
  Mabitso ao u a bonang projekeng ea hau (mabitso a li-layer, mabitso a li-effect) a lula e le a
  Senyesemane e le hore a ntse a lumellana le After Effects.
- Popup ea “lintho tse ncha” le eona e fetoletsoe, ho tloha phatlalatsong ena.

E NCHA: LI-THEME TSA DEMON SLAYER
- Litlhophiso tsa Flex > THEME SELECTOR li na le sehlopha se secha sa DEMON SLAYER se nang le li-theme tse 11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen le Kokushibo.
- Sisinya mouse holim'a panele 'me ntho ea theme e e latela: metsi, malakabe, lehalima,
  lirurubele, makhasi a lipalesa, moholi le tse ling. Ha mouse e ema,
  e nyamela butle.
- Click button 'me sabole ea sebapali seo e a e seha. Tšoara button ea mouse e ka ho le letšehali 'me e
  tsoela pele ho seha; e tšoare ka metsotsoana e ka bang 2.5 'me e a phatloha.
- E entsoe hore e lule e le bobebe: li-effect li sebetsa feela ha u sisinya kapa u click, 'me li ba bobebe
  ka bohona likhomphuteng tse liehang. Tima AMBIENT EFFECTS ho Theme Selector ho boloka
  mebala feela.

E FETOHILE: LI-BUTTON TSE BATALETSENG LI-THEME TSOHLE
- Li-button tse sebetsang le tse kholo ho li-theme tsa mebala ha li sa sebelise gradient e nang le moriti ho tloha
  holimo ho ea tlase. Ke mmala o le mong o bataletseng o nang le glow e bonolo, kahoo li
  shebahala li hloekile 'me li bala hantle.

E LOKISITSOE
- Karete ea laesense le popup ea “lintho tse ncha” li ne li ka buleha e 'ngoe holim'a e 'ngoe. Hona joale
  ha li sa kopane, 'me letšoao la NTLAFATSA ha le sa koahele li-button tse ka holimo
  ho panele.
- Ho UI SCALE 125% le 150%, li-window tse ling (joalo ka Litlhophiso tsa Flex) li ne li ka ba telele ho feta
  panele, kahoo konopo ea tsona ea ho koala e ne e tsoa pontšong. Hona joale window e 'ngoe
  le e 'ngoe e lekana boholo bo bong le bo bong.
- Windows: AutoCaptions e ne e ka re “NVIDIA DRIVER E TSOFETSE HO FETISA BAKENG SA GPU CAPTIONS” ho li-card
  le li-driver tse ncha (RTX 40 le 50 series). Hona joale e bala tšehetso ea CUDA ea driver ka nepo
  'me e sebelisa GPU ea hau.

TSE SA FETOHANG
- Laesense, activation le link e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe li sebetsa ka tsela e tšoanang le pele.
- Li-tab tse ling tsohle le lisebelisoa li sebetsa ka tsela e tšoanang le ho 9.2.7.
================================================================================

ult.message:
FLEX ULTIMATE BAKENG SA PREMIERE PRO - LINTHO TSE NCHA
Phatlalatso 2.2.8  -  Mphalane 2026

Li-caption tsa CAPTION STACK hona joale ke li-template tsa Motion Graphics TSE KA LOKISOANG tse nang le editor ea
'nete, ho na le AUDIO STUDIO e ncha le MARK AUDIO BEATS, panele e bua LIPUO TSE 132, UI SCALE e fihlile ho
ULTIMATE, 'me ho na le LI-THEME tse ncha tsa DEMON SLAYER.

PELE U QALA
- Kenya holim'a phatlalatso ea hau ea hajoale ka ZXP installer ea hau e tloaelehileng, ebe u qala
  Premiere Pro hape hang.
- Litlhophiso tsa hau, theme le li-preset lia bolokoa.

E NCHA: CAPTION STACK - LI-CAPTION TSE KA LOKISOANG (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Li-caption hona joale li behoa e le li-template tsa Motion Graphics tse ka lokisoang (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, e ncha e leng default ho Premiere Pro 2026). Kamora ho beha, fetola
  lentsoe leha e le lefe, font, mmala, boholo, boemo, glow, outline, box, animation kapa nako
  ka panele ea Essential Graphics ea Premiere.
- Output > LITŠOANTŠO e ntse e beha lentsoe le leng le le leng e le setšoantšo se nang le sebopeho sa
  'nete, haeba u e rata.
- Li-template li tla le panele. Ha ho letho leo u lokelang ho le download.

E NCHA: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview hona joale e bontša frame ea 'nete ea video ea hau tlas'a caption e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.
- Hula caption ho e sisinya, sebelisa sekhutlo ho fetola boholo le ntlha e ka holimo ho e potoloha,
  double-click lentsoe ho le lokisa. WHOLE CAPTION e sisinya mantsoe 'ohle hammoho,
  ONE WORD e sisinya lentsoe le le leng.
- Khetha hore na phetoho e sebetsa ho li-caption tsohle kapa ho caption ena feela, 'me boloka
  li-layout tsa hau hore u li sebelise hape.
- Libopeho tse 10 tse ncha tsa GLOW: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow le Superb.

E NCHA: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Khetha audio clip, khetha effect 'me u tobetse SEBELISA. Ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e sebetsa
  khomphuteng ea hau.
- Li-preset tse 30 tsa click e le 'ngoe: Underwater, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse le tse ling. Kopanya
  li-effect tseo u li ratang, u li hlophise hape kapa u time e le 'ngoe.
- Reverb e boloka mohatla oa eona: molumo o tsoela pele ka mora qetello ea clip, 'me o behoa hore
  ha ho letho ho timeline ea hau le ka ngoloang holim'a lona.
- Lisebelisoa: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  le Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER e arola pina ka li-vocal le mmino (kapa li-stem tse 4). E download model ea eona la pele
  'me e u botsa pele.
- PREVIEW e u lumella ho utloa metsotsoana e ka bang 8 ka switch ea Original / Processed. Sephetho
  se ea ho audio track e se nang letho 'me clip ea hau ea mantlha e homisoa,
  ha e hlakoloe ka mohla.

E NCHA: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Khetha clip ea mmino ho timeline 'me u tobetse MARK BEATS: Flex e fumana li-beat 'me e
  eketsa li-marker tsa sequence holim'a tsona, e le hore li-cut tsa hau li lumellane
  hantle le mmino.
- Khetha hits TSOHLE, KICKS kapa SNARES, beha sensitivity, 'me u tšoaee beat e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe kapa
  beat ea bobeli kapa ea bone e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS e tlosa feela li-marker tseo Flex e li eketseng. E sebetsa khomphuteng
  ea hau.
